title: S&K Aerospace and SalesPatriot Partner to Transform Sustainment Operations for U.S. and Allied Forces with AI
summary: S&K, the tribally owned sustainment company supporting more than 100 partner nations and every U.S. military service, will deploy SalesPatriot’s AI across its MRO enterprise
body_markdown: Every year, tens of thousands of parts and repair requirements from every U.S. military service and more than 100 partner nations flow through S&K’s operations in Warner Robins, Georgia, and behind each one is an aircraft waiting on a part. S&K manages more than $4 billion in assets on behalf of those customers. As the demands on the warfighter have grown, so has the need for innovation, not only in the hardware that flies but in the digital systems that get the right part to the right place in time. To meet that need, SalesPatriot and S&K have partnered to strengthen warfighter and allied readiness. Together, they are integrating demand signals and systems into one operating picture, automating the work between a requirement and a response, and giving S&K’s leadership real-time visibility across all of the programs they support.
